verdict.rationale: Sentry hosts its own public sandbox (sandbox.sentry.io) with sample issue data, isolated from customer production data, so a user can explore without touching production. However, it is documented only as a product-UI demo showroom, not as an environment for testing API, MCP or agent calls, which is what an AI-native user would need. Self-hosting and MCP org/project scoping are workarounds or adjacent controls and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test environment for API/MCP/agent calls, test credentials or keys separated from production, documentation of how to test agent workflows against it, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: an email-gated demo environment pre-populated with sample issue data and isolated from any customer's production data
